h1: The 5 Best 18V Leaf Blowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five cordless leaf blowers on the Milwaukee M18 18V platform, including brand-name tools and battery-compatible budget options.
summary: The Milwaukee M18 FUEL 450 CFM is our top pick, with a brushless motor and 120 MPH. The Milwaukee M18 FUEL Blower is the other full-power brand option. If you already own M18 batteries, the ALDIPRO at 700 CFM and the Houselife at 600 CFM are the lower-cost blowers, while the Milwaukee 0884-20 is the compact yard model.
intro: An 18V blower is really a choice about batteries. The tool is the cheap part, and buying into the wrong battery system means a second charger and a second set of packs you will never share with your drill.

Every pick here runs on Milwaukee's M18 18-volt platform, either as a Milwaukee tool or a blower that lists M18 battery compatibility. We reviewed their listed airflow and positioning and ranked five. Blowers built for other battery systems were left out.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 120 MPH 450 CFM 18-Volt Lithium Ion Brushless
products.verdict: A brushless 18V handheld with 120 MPH and 450 CFM.
products.description:
The Milwaukee M18 FUEL is a handheld 18-volt lithium-ion brushless blower listed at 120 MPH and 450 CFM. It sits in the $100-200 bucket.

It wins by pairing the brand's brushless FUEL line with a clear pair of airflow numbers. The compatible blowers below list more CFM but are not Milwaukee tools.

It suits owners already invested in M18. Check whether the battery comes in the box.
products.idealFor: M18 owners wanting a brand-name blower.
products.skipIf: You want the most CFM per dollar.

products.name: Milwaukee Electric - M18 FUELTRADE Blower
products.verdict: A second FUEL-line blower with few listed specs.
products.description:
The M18 FUEL blower is another Milwaukee leaf blower in the $100-200 bucket. The listing here gives no airflow or speed figure.

Second place reflects the brand name but a spec sheet that cannot be compared to the top pick.

It is for M18 loyalists who will research the specs on the full listing.
products.idealFor: M18 loyalists who will research specs.

products.name: Milwaukee 0884-20 M18 18 Volt Cordless Compact Yard Leaf Blower
products.verdict: A compact handheld yard blower at 100 CFM and 160 MPH.
products.description:
The Milwaukee 0884-20 is a compact handheld 18-volt blower. A second listing for the same model shows 100 CFM and 160 MPH. It sits in the $100-200 bucket.

It ranks third because 100 CFM is far lower than the others, even though the speed number looks high.

It suits light patio and path clearing. It is a tool-only model, so you need an M18 battery.

products.name: ALDIPRO 700 CFM Leaf Blower Compatible with Milwaukee M18 Battery
products.verdict: 700 CFM on an M18 battery, at the lowest price bucket.
products.description:
The ALDIPRO is a cordless blower listed at 700 CFM that is compatible with the Milwaukee M18 battery. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

It places fourth because it lists the most airflow here but is not a Milwaukee tool and has no brand heritage. It is the cheapest way to get high CFM from M18 packs.

It suits owners with spare M18 batteries. Battery is not included.
products.skipIf: You do not own M18 packs.

products.name: Houselife 600 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower Compatible with Milwaukee 18V M18 Battery
products.verdict: A 600 CFM handheld that takes M18 batteries.
products.description:
The Houselife is a handheld cordless blower listed at 600 CFM and compatible with Milwaukee 18V M18 batteries. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

It finishes behind the ALDIPRO because it lists 100 CFM less at a similar bucket.

It suits yard owners who want low cost on the M18 platform. No battery is included.

whatMatters.detail: A blower that uses your existing batteries saves the cost of a second pack and charger. It matters more than the blower itself. Check the compatibility statement in the title.
Tool-only listings sell the blower without a battery or charger. Kits include them. Read the listing before you assume the battery is in the box.
CFM is air volume and MPH is air speed. Volume moves piles, speed lifts debris. Look for both numbers and be wary when one is missing.
A brushless motor is generally more efficient and durable than a brushed one. It matters for run time. Look for the word brushless.
Compatible blowers are cheaper but lack the brand's support. Decide if you value the name. Check seller details.

faq.q: Do these blowers include a battery?
faq.a: Do not assume so. Check each listing, since several are tool-only.
Buying a blower for a different battery system than the one you own.

faq.q: Is the Milwaukee worth it over the ALDIPRO?
faq.a: If you value the brand and brushless motor, yes. The ALDIPRO lists more CFM for less.
Read the title and confirm M18 or 18V is stated.

faq.q: How do I care for the battery?
faq.a: Store it per the maker's manual and charge it with the correct charger.

faq.q: Why does the 0884-20 list low CFM?
faq.a: It is a compact model at 100 CFM and 160 MPH, built for light work.

finalTake: The Milwaukee M18 FUEL 450 CFM is the dependable choice on the M18 platform. If you already own packs, the ALDIPRO gives the most listed CFM for the least. Choose the battery first and the blower second.
